objective: Repository source and committed history inside the required scan scope contain no exposed live credential material.

required_scope.rule: Each required evidence kind is one provider assessment of the declared target. An evidence record proves only the scope it declares.

status_semantics.PASS: The required provider assessment completed for the declared scope and no violating finding exists.
status_semantics.FAIL: The required provider assessment completed for the declared scope and one or more violating findings exist.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: The required provider assessment cannot reliably complete, or completed without established coverage of the declared scope.

out_of_scope: Whether a discovered credential is still valid, revoked, or rotated.
Secret stores outside repository content, such as runtime environments, secret managers, and masked CI variables.
Authorization, data-flow, dependency, and application-source controls.
Any project or system security verdict; this control emits one scoped evidence record per assessment.
